visual_identity.core_identity: Small ugly flying blood-feeders combining batlike membrane wings with long needle proboscises and grasping feet.
visual_identity.silhouette: Several small airborne bodies with outspread membrane wings and long straight proboscises projecting from their faces.
visual_identity.head_features: Small animal-like head dominated by a long needle feeding tube, simple eyes, and no humanoid expression.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact flying body with membranous wings, small grasping feet, and narrow abdomen.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth membrane wings and sparse body texture; avoid dense insect detail.
